before.blocker: The installed profile is valid, but the project lacks target-specific Release profile selection; a global override incorrectly applies the app profile to the MCP helper.

checks.command: Inspect installed Disk Steward Developer ID Distribution provisioning profile
checks.result: passed: installed profile 193d15aa-43f8-4477-bdab-58cf2e59964f targets G3P6TU385Y.com.marudankiji.disksteward, authorizes group.com.marudankiji.disksteward, selects the Developer ID Application certificate, and expires 2044-09-08
failed: Xcode still requires the application target to select a provisioning profile

checks.command: /usr/bin/xcodebuild ... PROVISIONING_PROFILE_SPECIFIER=Disk Steward Developer ID Distribution archive
checks.result: failed: the global override correctly reaches the profile but incorrectly applies it to disk-witness-mcp, which does not support provisioning profiles

acceptance_evidence.reference: No exact exported artifact exists because the current project cannot apply the Developer ID profile only to the DiskSteward application target.
The release remains blocked without weakening signatures, entitlements, notarization, or Gatekeeper requirements; remediation is a target-specific profile setting in the release-packaging task.

discovered_risks: A project-wide PROVISIONING_PROFILE_SPECIFIER applies the app profile to the MCP command-line helper and prevents archiving.
The application target currently has no target-specific Release profile selector, so Xcode cannot complete manual Developer ID signing.

evidence: OUTCOME-210, TASK-310, and RISK-320 are verified against the current schema-v5 candidate
The current app passed 156 Swift tests, a signed Debug Xcode build, UI smoke, durable multi-slice reconciliation, actionable menu export, MCP access, privacy, and distribution-negative tests
Scripts/Distribution/release-preflight exited 66: no Developer ID Application identity for Team G3P6TU385Y is installed
Apple Development and Apple Distribution identities are explicitly rejected as substitutes for a direct-distribution Developer ID Application signature
Without a Developer ID Application signed export there is no exact release artifact to submit for notarization
Therefore notarization acceptance, staple validation, Gatekeeper acceptance, release-artifact hash, and exported-app launch cannot truthfully be claimed
The credential-free rehearsal constructed and inspected an unsigned archive, rejected it, removed the temporary archive, and left the development build usable

Exact remediation: the Apple Developer Account Holder must create or authorize a Developer ID Application certificate, install it with its private key in the login keychain through Xcode Settings > Accounts > Marudan Kiji > Manage Certificates, then run the documented archive/export/notarize/verify workflow

last_audit.recommended_action: Obtain and install a Developer ID Application identity with its private key, export and notarize the exact app through Xcode Organizer, staple it, then rerun Scripts/Distribution/verify-release and this final gate.
